name: QR payment for WooCommerce
author: WebBaker

sections.description:
Simplify payments by bank transfer with automatic QR code generation.

The QR Payment plugin for WooCommerce will generate a QR code according to the order total and the IBAN of the account you choose in the plugin settings. The order completion page then displays a section with the QR code, which can be supplemented with custom text. Depending on the settings, the QR code can also be automatically sent in an email along with the order. The customer can scan the QR code with any banking application and all payment details will be pre-populated.

The plugin does not require any integration of third party services. QR code generation is done directly in the plugin and is free for an unlimited number of orders.

Currently supported countries: SK, CZ.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure you have WooCommerce installed and configured.
  2. Go to the Direct Bank transfer payment settings (WooCommerce Settings > Payments > Manage), or click on the plugin’s “Settings” in the plugin list.
  3. Set the QR code generation parameters in the “QR Payment Settings” section.
  4. Create an order with the payment method of account transfer.
  5. Check the correct generation of the QR code by the mobile application.
